summary: Backend testing for Stages 6-9 (Leave/WFH workflows, HR RBAC, Data cleanup). Created pytest suite with 15 tests covering all requested endpoints. All 15/15 tests PASSED. Created a TEST HR user (TEST_hr_user@bankezee.com / HrTest12!!) via /api/auth/register to verify HR RBAC. Verified: leave balance defaults (casual=12, sick=6, earned=15, unpaid=Unlimited), leave request submission with weekday date calc (leave_days>=1 confirmed), invalid leave type rejection (400), end-before-start rejection (400), GET my requests, HR/admin gating on /leave/requests/pending (403 for telecaller), approval flow (PATCH -> status APPROVED), WFH submission, HR user gets 403 on /api/leads while being allowed on /leave/requests/pending and /leave/balance, data-cleanup /stats, /call-log-analysis, /deduplicate-call-logs dry_run (deleted_count absent when dry_run=true), and telecaller forbidden from cleanup endpoints.

minor.issue: Only GET /api/leads list has require_not_hr. Other lead endpoints (GET /api/leads/{id}, PATCH, DELETE, stats, unassigned, assign, bulk operations) use require_admin or get_current_user without require_not_hr. Since HR is a non-admin role, admin-only endpoints already block HR, but shared endpoints like GET /api/leads/{id} and GET /api/leads/stats currently allow HR access. Recommend applying require_not_hr consistently on all lead/call/report endpoints to fully enforce 'HR cannot access customer data'.

Endpoint is public (no auth dependency) and accepts arbitrary role including 'hr' and 'admin'. This allows unauthenticated privilege escalation. Should require admin auth to create hr/admin users, or restrict role field to 'telecaller' for public registration.
Stores plain_password field on user document alongside hashed password - security concern (plaintext credential retention).

Uses datetime.now().year (naive) in one place and datetime.now(timezone.utc).year in another - minor inconsistency; also aggregation includes UNPAID/EMERGENCY/GENERAL types but the balance response only surfaces 4 categories (EMERGENCY & GENERAL used-days are dropped).
Groups by 10-minute time_bucket which could over-aggregate legitimate distinct calls to the same lead within 10 min; consider stricter matching (same duration ± N sec, or same device_timestamp).

action_items: Consider applying require_not_hr to remaining /api/leads/*, /api/calls/*, /api/reports/* endpoints for defense-in-depth (currently only GET /api/leads list is guarded).
Secure /api/auth/register: require admin auth OR restrict role field so unauthenticated users cannot self-register as admin/hr.
Remove plain_password storage in user documents.
Configure RESEND_API_KEY for real email delivery (currently notifications silently no-op, which is acceptable per spec).
critical_code_review_comments: leave_management.py is 550 lines - approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into leave_requests.py + wfh.py + balances.py.
Duplicate leave-days aggregation logic between /leave/balance and /leave/balances/all - extract into a helper.
handle_leave_request builds attendance records inline; extract to helper for testability.
Public /api/auth/register accepting role=admin/hr is a security bug (see action items).
